objective: Recover a pinned Wall-OSS PyTorch BF16 golden and freeze one ONNX candidate on 5090-zem, then build and prove or reject its SM87 TensorRT engine package on agx-test without changing the frozen model ABI.
non_goals: Do not implement or run the pi.cpp C++ backend, latency, server/client, closed-loop, or promotion in Revision 7.
Do not treat ORT provider placement or numerical parity as the production golden or AGX deployment evidence.
Do not modify the frozen v18 package or any Revision 5/6 evidence.
Do not create v19 unless a specific exporter graph defect is located first.
inputs: Frozen v18 package and real PyTorch fixture SHA256 681e62ba720cc4b7830d1d7b5f4e6c7afb564ad0705862245f3cfa84433f9c45
outputs: Pinned calibration and held-out PyTorch golden with BF16 bit identity and x1..x10
Teacher-forced prefill and prefix/prefill root-cause evidence
One immutable v18 or minimally repaired v19 candidate manifest
Target-built AGX TensorRT engine package or an early rejection report

interfaces.input: Frozen model ABI, pinned source/checkpoint, self-consistent calibration and held-out PyTorch golden.
interfaces.output: Exactly one immutable ONNX package and complete relative-path SHA256 tree.
interfaces.change_control: Any dtype, stage, tensor, shape, KV, D10, x0, normalization, or candidate file change invalidates the freeze and requires a new contract revision.

work_packages.goal: Freeze the Revision 7 topology, numerical thresholds, safety boundaries, and evidence claims.
Audit both hosts, validate fixture lineage and BF16 identity, recover calibration and held-out PyTorch references, and add x1..x10.
inputs: Pinned source, checkpoint, processor, v18 and fixture
outputs: Reference manifests and golden completeness evidence

work_packages.goal: Run teacher-forced prefill, same-host PyTorch ladder, token/layer drift analysis, and PT/ORT 2x2 matrix in a fresh 5090 directory.
inputs: Complete pinned golden and 5090 execution approval

work_packages.goal: Retain v18 or minimally repair one proven exporter defect into v19, validate all fixtures, and freeze one candidate.
Transfer, verify, ingest, and build the frozen candidate on the target SM87/TensorRT 10.3 host.
inputs: revision7-candidate-package and explicit AGX build approval

work_packages.goal: Compare target TensorRT stage, all 72 KV tensors, x1..x10, and final actions directly against the pinned PyTorch golden.

integration_owner: primary Codex agent under human acceptance gates

safety: Do not stop or interfere with the root-owned DStereo process currently occupying 5090-zem.
Do not use AGX rootfs, /tmp, or /dev/shm for artifacts or build scratch.
Stop before AGX build if its fresh NVMe capacity budget is insufficient.
constraints.reversibility: All artifacts are additive in fresh revision directories; v18, Revision 5/6 evidence, accepted backends, and services remain untouched.
constraints.budget: 5090 execution waits for a conflict-free GPU; AGX build requires a fresh storage budget and exact human approval.

promotion.rule: Only a passed target TensorRT parity decision may unlock Revision 8; no accepted backend or service is modified by Revision 7.
